description: Rain-soaked Bellwether Aquarium work order marked NORTH WING, signed N. Reyes, wall-clock time 20:30, dated on Carmen’s birthday.
June’s handwritten list headed “People who got better overnight,” with thirty-one names and Lyle Boone near the top.
Midnight view from the boathouse: townspeople walking down Harbor Path into glowing surf, a woman in a good wool coat turning back at the waterline, and a small old woman on the steps.
The windowless Meridian meeting room seen through frost, matching the p_meeting painting and reading clearly as a preserved memory fragment.
Gus’s bakery van at the loading door with an oversized croissant mounted on its roof.
Row Zero in the amber Gallery, with one enormous eye open beneath cracked frost.
Helen's last notebook page: a short flat stroke, a joined rising stroke, a gap, then a long lower stroke, with the margin note "repeats after the low note".
display: task art for c8_lab.lastpage, reused in c9_choir.wick and postcredits.answer
